title: Refactor Workflow Modules and Close Common Gaps

story.so_that: the orchestrator/common refactor boundary is clean, the codebase is maintainable, and the workflow engine runs with correctly configured logging and verified behavior
story.i_want: to clean up dead and duplicate orchestrator modules, restore common skill-activity extensibility, move workflow logging configuration into common, and complete common module test coverage

journey.before: Maintains a partially-refactored codebase where orchestrator and common both contain harness, skill-activity, and logging implementations; several common tests do not exercise log paths, stdout/stderr capture, or SkillActivityOutput fields.
journey.during: Uses gaps.md to identify dead duplicates, ports remaining behavior (harness config overrides, prompt output-directory instruction, skill-activity extensibility hooks and run_skill helper, worker logging setup API) to common, relocates workflow_logging.config.json, removes stale orchestrator files/tests/docs, and adds missing tests.
journey.after: Orchestrator contains only composition-root code; common owns all generic workflow infrastructure; tests verify log file paths and contents; the full pytest suite passes; live workflow runs produce the expected log tree.

capability_breakdown.core_action: Complete the migration of generic workflow infrastructure from orchestrator to common and close the remaining behavior and test-coverage gaps
inputs: existing orchestrator dead modules and tests
existing test suites and live workflow verification results
outputs: clean common module with migrated behavior
removed dead or duplicate orchestrator files, tests, and stale documentation
common workflow logging configuration loaded from src/common/workflow_logging.config.json
expanded common test coverage for logging, harness output, and skill-activity outputs
passing full pytest suite and expected live log tree
state_changes: Dead orchestrator modules and tests are deleted
Common skill_activity.py gains extensibility hooks and a run_skill helper
Common workflow_logger.py uses src/common/workflow_logging.config.json as its configuration source
Orchestrator wiring passes logging configuration during worker setup

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Dead and duplicate orchestrator files, configuration, tests, and stale documentation are removed and the live common equivalents remain functional
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the gaps.md refactor plan When the implementation is complete Then src/orchestrator/harness.py, devin_harness.py, skill_activity.py, workflow_logger.py, invocation_context.py, skill_activity_config.py, devin_harness.config.json, workflow_logging.config.json, stale orchestrator tests, README.md, and vault/services/orchestrator-harness.md are removed while common equivalents continue to work

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Common skill_activity.py exposes extensibility hooks and a run_skill helper equivalent to the removed orchestrator version while preserving the fixed execute template
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given common/skill_activity.py currently omits modify hooks and a run_skill helper When the implementation is complete Then the common module provides equivalent extensibility hooks and a run_skill helper without breaking the SkillActivity.execute lifecycle

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Workflow logging configuration is stored with common and passed through orchestrator setup so WorkflowLoggerConfig.load uses src/common/workflow_logging.config.json
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given common/workflow_logger.py looks for src/common/workflow_logging.config.json When the orchestrator sets up logging Then the configuration is loaded from the common file and wired into the orchestrator startup process

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Common module test coverage is expanded to exercise workflow and client log contexts, log path helpers, stdout/stderr capture to devin.log, and SkillActivityOutput log paths plus file creation
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given the common test suite currently omits several behaviors When the missing tests are added Then workflow_log_context, client_log_context, get_workflow_log_path, get_client_log_path, stdout/stderr capture to devin.log, and SkillActivityOutput activity_log_path/devin_log_path with file creation are all asserted

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The full pytest suite passes and a live workflow run produces the expected log tree
acceptance_criteria.gherkin: Given all refactor and coverage changes are applied When the tests run and a live workflow executes Then nix-shell --run pytest passes and the log tree contains workflow.log, client.log, and activities/<activity_type>_<activity_id>_<attempt>/{activity.log,devin.log,devin-trajectory.json}
acceptance_criteria.jtbd: Confirm refactor does not break tests
